introduction: Match equivalent characters without changing your text.
nextSearch: Changes apply to your next search.

searchEnabled.name: Search
searchEnabled.unavailable: Search is disabled. Enable Search in Core plugins to use this feature.

findEnabled.name: Find
findEnabled.description: Search within the current Markdown note. Replacements stay unchanged.

quickSwitcherEnabled.name: Quick switcher
quickSwitcherEnabled.description: Match file names, paths, and aliases.
quickSwitcherEnabled.unavailable: Quick switcher is disabled. Enable Quick switcher in Core plugins to use this feature.

graphEnabled.name: Graph view
graphEnabled.description: Match equivalent characters in global and local graph filters and groups.
graphEnabled.unavailable: Enable Graph view in Core plugins to use this feature.

graphAdvancedQueries.name: Advanced graph queries
graphAdvancedQueries.description: Also match equivalent characters in path:, file:, and tag: filters. Exclusions also include equivalent forms. Requires Graph view enhancement.

tagsEnabled.name: Tags
tagsEnabled.description: Suggest equivalent tags after # in the Markdown editor. Insert the original tag.

internalLinksEnabled.name: Internal links
internalLinksEnabled.description: Suggest equivalent file names, paths, and aliases after [[. Headings, blocks, and display text stay unchanged.

fullCompatibility.name: Compatibility characters
fullCompatibility.description: Also match forms such as ① / 1, Ａ / A, and ﬃ / ffi. Turning this off keeps built-in matching unchanged.

diagnosticsPrinted: Diagnostics written to the console. Filter by [CJK-Probe].

errors.settingsSave: Could not save this setting. Your previous choice is still active. Check vault access and try again.
errors.dataInvalid: Character data could not be loaded. Built-in search is unchanged. Reload CJK Search to try again.
errors.incompatible: This search interface is not supported. Built-in search is unchanged. Use Print diagnostics to help troubleshoot.
errors.limit: This query exceeds the enhancement limit. Built-in search is used for this query.
errors.nativeInterface: Search could not be enhanced. Built-in search is used instead. Use Print diagnostics to help troubleshoot.
errors.enhancementUpdate: Could not update search enhancements. Reload CJK Search to try again.

language.name: Language
language.description: Choose the plugin language. Search matching stays unchanged.
